decisions.reason: As a flagship adapter tied closely to the firm’s modular lighting direction, it likely remains above aspiration or is protected by strategic commitment and available slack despite limited later evidence.
This LED luminaire line is close to the core assortment, and in a growing industry a German premium lighting firm would usually keep such a line unless performance clearly fell short of aspirations.

The home automation server box is more adjacent to the core business and likely carries higher software and support demands, so if its results are uncertain or below aspiration management would more readily reallocate those resources.

A luminaire family with several models fits the firm’s established premium range and retailer/showroom logic, so boundedly rational management would typically retain it while no strong failure signal is visible.
